derived_current_contracts: BACKEND_AUTHORITY_CENTRALIZATION: all model/tool backend calls inherit one typed router/fallback authority; hidden direct-port bypasses are regressions.
HANDOFF_CONTEXT_INVARIANT: model/provider fallback preserves authorized system/task/conversation context without hardcoded unverifiable self-claims.
MEMORY_PROVENANCE_SEPARATION: user facts, assistant outputs, summaries and inferred claims remain distinct provenance classes.
RECOVERY_EPOCH_COMPATIBILITY: restore requires snapshot epoch, schema/model compatibility, selective scope, backup receipt and rollback path.
NO_FIXED_CONFIDENCE_FOR_EXTRACTED_EVIDENCE: extracted findings keep source/result provenance and UNKNOWN confidence until validated.
BOUNDED_RUNTIME_STATE: caches/UI buffers/background queues require explicit caps/eviction/settle behavior.
MECHANISM_NOT_SELF_CLAIM: prompt or architecture assertions about consciousness/feelings/agency are not evidence.
AUTHORITATIVE_WORLD_GROUNDING_OVER_BLACKLISTS: registry/state resolution beats enumerative place/experience regexes.
